entry.title: € 299.000 Building Commercial 3+1 bedrooms Aljezur - terrace, privileged location (Provenda)
entry.content: SaleLocated on Aljezur’s main street, this building is registered as a residential property, but its prime location also makes it suitable for commercial use. It is spread over two floors with separate entrances. The ground floor is currently used as an office and includes a bathroom. The upper floor has three bedrooms, a living room, a kitchen and a bathroom. An external staircase leads up to a terrace. Fun fact: this building, constructed in 1913, was Aljezur’s first registered guesthouse, a true historical landmark of the town. Just a 10-minute drive away are some of the wildest and most unspoilt beaches on the Costa Vicentina, with golden sand, dramatic cliffs and hidden coves where nature takes centre stage. Praia da Amoreira is about 5 km from the house, and the neighbouring Praia da Arrifana and Monte Clérigo, favourites with surfers, are right next to it. This village offers all the essential amenities, including supermarkets, local cafés and restaurants, a health centre, a school, banks and a post office, as well as a medieval castle and charming cobbled streets. The lively towns of Sagres and Lagos are about 30 km away, and Faro Airport is approximately 125 km away. Perfect for those seeking an authentic experience surrounded by nature, away from the crowds, this house is a serene retreat where the Algarve reveals its most genuine and timeless side.
